config.purpose: E3: test whether more and more diverse public training data improves the generalization of the Medium joint schema head. E2 size ablations showed this 25.21M-parameter head has capacity to overfit v2. Preserve E2-Medium head and AdamW recipe, seed, four-record microbatches, effective batch 64 and five full epochs; expand to v3 cached frozen Qwen3.5-9B features. Select by dev NLL, fit temperature on calibration only, then evaluate the locked model on the existing benchmark panel. Training on more data at fixed epochs entails more optimizer steps; validation/calibration composition also expands.
